feeds.title: SA Hip Hop Music Blog
feeds.description: SA Hip Hop Music Blog is a marketing agency that promotes South African Hip Hop through digital content creation, music, events, fashion, lifestyle, cars & semi-urban street culture. Established in 2016, it is the leading authority on the South African Hip Hop movement and has helped to launch the careers of many artists, producers, DJs & content creators.

feeds.title: SA Hip Hop Mag
feeds.description: Dive into the rhythm and join in the vibrant world of South African Hip Hop. SA Hip Hop Mag is South Africa's number 1 hip hop Mag for the latest & breaking SA Hip Hop News and downloads, SA hip hop interviews, SA hip hop videos and new SA hip hop music.

feeds.title: Rap Type Mag
feeds.description: Rap Type, as South African/ Mzansi's Hip hop/ Rap Music Online Magazine brings you the latest scoops covering Celebrities, Music, News, Videos, Entertainment, and Lifestyle. Join on a journey through the beats, rhymes, and stories that shape the Hip Hop culture of South Africa.

feeds.title: SA Hip Hop 247
feeds.description: Stay in the loop with the freshest drops, and the latest in Hip Hop's entertainment scene. Presenting SA Hip Hop 247, the new breed of music branding. Focused on delivering promo/marketing with tailored-multi channel strategies for artists & labels, SA Hip Hop 247 specializes in digital mixtape hosting & services on all platforms.

feeds.title: Fakaza
feeds.description: Find the latest South African albums and news online. Visit Fakaza and enjoy the latest music albums, music releases, and news about the latest South African music. Fakaza.com is the online home to some of the hottest and freshest musical sensations in South Africa's music scene.

feeds.title: Mzansi Reggae
feeds.description: Mzansi Reggae is an online magazine established to serve as a source of news and a primal destination for information about Reggae music and culture in Southern Africa. Providing a much-needed outlet for access to new music, album, and gig reviews, articles, details about upcoming events, and other subjects to those who share an obsession with Reggae music.

feeds.title: Bluntmagza » Hip Hop
feeds.description: Keep the pulse of SA Hip Hop's entertainment world with original stories, fun articles, interviews, and more. Founded in 1997, Blunt is South Africa's much-loved alternative magazine with the purpose of being the unbiased voice of independent like-minded progressive subcultures in South Africa and beyond.

feeds.title: Pyramid Magazine
feeds.description: Everything Vaal Hip Hop and More - Pyramid is an online digital magazine documenting the #VaalHipHop movement to be recognized in the Industry. It is only focused on Entertainment, but also covers inspirational stories, Profiles, and content teaching about the Music Industry.
